text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  we sketched mitigations but didn't lock owners for the contractual and detection work. Need a clear handoff for uptime safeguards and recurrence monitoring.

peter: I can take vendor remediation tracking (INF-4701). I'll request a written remediation plan with milestones and ask for a token-endpoint uptime commitment. ETA 48h.

sophia: I'll own engineering mitigations for registry (INF-4702)  implement read-only fallback, warm local cache for hot models, and add a rollback play. Draft runbook + staging sim by next Wed.

elaine: Thanks. Also want a short experiment to quantify model drift vs cache TTL before we enable fallback in prod.

sophia: Agree. I'll run a replay harness against last month's traces and surface a short report (staleness vs quality).

devops-bot: Epic created: https://tracker.internal/INF-4700 "Uptime safeguards & recurrence handoff". Tasks INF-4701..INF-4706 created.

peter: Legal: can you be on standby to review vendor remediation and SLA edits when INF-4701 has vendor reply? We'll need clear RTO/RPO and escalation path.

legal: Will review. Ask vendor to provide remediation milestones, postmortem template, and a contact matrix. Prioritize token endpoints.

elaine: Operational detection: can someone add a composite alert that pages when (auth_p95>200ms && registry_error_rate>1%) for 5m, and a monthly recurrence digest?

product: I'll take product sign-off on acceptable staleness and a degradation matrix (read-only, cache-first, reject). Will provide criteria in 4 business days.

peter: I'll also open a procurement/legal escalation play if vendor timeline is incomplete after 72h.

sophia: Action summary:
- peter: vendor remediation & SLA (INF-4701)  48h
- sophia: registry fallback + replay sim + rollback (INF-4702)  next Wed
- product: staleness sign-off  4 business days
- devops-bot: alerts + monthly digest (INF-4703)  3 days

elaine: I'll consolidate into INF-4700 and run a weekly check-in. Please add blockers to the epic and update progress. Closing thread and moving tracking to the epic. :white_check_mark:
